annotations.text: The product is one loop, left to right: scan the site, look at the findings, review a single proposed fix, approve the batch. Everything on the row below exists to support that loop.

Deliberate scope: every number on these screens comes from crawling the customer's own site or from their own Search Console. No backlink index, no keyword database, no bought rank data - so cost per site stays near zero and there is no vendor to license.

The difference sits in Connections and Review a fix: changes are written into something the customer owns and every one can be rolled back. The crowded end of this market injects changes with a script that disappears when you stop paying.
